title: Remove legacy tracker and process references from GLOBAL docs
body:
GLOBAL docs and help texts still describe the Git-ref ticket queue, Paperclip import, JSONL tracker storage, a next command, missing test scripts, and ADR status headers that omit later supersession.
Acceptance: research pages, ADR status headers and index, test-audit script names and the herdr hook ownership note match current code and ADR 0014/0015; deletions follow D19.
